- Next: read task file state and either create/verify plan or execute existing NOW EXECUTE plan.

- Read task-1-rename-to-opentk-sync.md; it had no existing plan or NOW EXECUTE marker.
- Scanned references and found production code already appears renamed to opentk-sync with an existing contract test, but task metadata was not planned/executed.
- Created .ralph/tasks/story-7-binary-rename-and-cdc/task-1-rename-to-opentk-sync_plans/rename-binary-plan.md using tdd and improve-code-boundaries guidance.
- Added the plan path and NOW EXECUTE marker to the task file.
- Per instructions for the planning branch, quit immediately without executing checks or code changes.

- Execution branch started for task-1-rename-to-opentk-sync.md; task file contains NOW EXECUTE.
- Re-read tdd and improve-code-boundaries skills.
- Plan says production rename likely already exists; current scan shows opentk-sync binary/source/clap name are present, with remaining complete-sync mentions in contract test name and docs/test filenames.
- Next: run focused contract and cargo help checks, inspect remaining complete-sync references, then update stale legacy names if needed.

- Verified `cargo run -p opentk-db --bin opentk-sync -- --help` succeeds and `--bin complete-sync` fails with no such bin target.
- Found stale legacy names in docs/complete-sync-verification.md, docs heading, opentk-sync runner test filename, and complete_sync_schema migration filenames.
- Renamed those repo surfaces to opentk-sync/opentk_sync/sync_schema and updated include_str! paths.
- Next: rerun focused tests/searches, then full make check/test/lint gates.

- `cargo clean` hung on the default target directory after several minutes; killed it and switched verification to a fresh `/tmp/opentk-target` via CARGO_TARGET_DIR.
- Current source search shows no stale complete-sync filenames; only the focused contract test still mentions the old name as the forbidden binary.
- Running focused contract test sequentially in the fresh target now.

- Focused production source contract passed in `/tmp/opentk-target`.
- `cargo run -p opentk-db --bin opentk-sync -- --help` passed in fresh target.
- `cargo run -p opentk-db --bin complete-sync -- --help` fails with no such bin target, as expected.
- Next: run required gates `make check`, `make test`, `make lint` with CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/tmp/opentk-target to avoid default target corruption.

- Required gates passed using CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/tmp/opentk-target: `make check`, `make test`, and `make lint`.
- Direct acceptance passed: new opentk-sync help works; old complete-sync cargo bin fails as absent.
- Final boundary scan found stale complete-sync names only in the contract test that asserts the old binary is removed.
- Marked task status done, passes true, and checked all acceptance criteria.
- Next: run .ralph/task_switch.sh, commit all files with required message, push, then quit.
